body.en: Each release now includes an x86_64 AppImage, tested on Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 and Fedora. You need a TeX distribution installed. The AI assistant is off on Linux for now, and the app does not update itself there: download new versions from the release page. Thanks to Stefan Bringuier for the first Linux port.
body.zh: 每个版本现在都附带 x86_64 AppImage，已在 Ubuntu 22.04、24.04 和 Fedora 上测试。需要先安装 TeX 发行版。Linux 上暂时关闭了 AI 助手，应用也不会自动更新：新版本请到发布页面下载。感谢 Stefan Bringuier 完成最初的 Linux 移植。

title.en: The AI assistant can continue your other Claude Code and Codex sessions
title.zh: AI 助手可以继续你在别处的 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话

body.en: Its history menu now lists the sessions you started for the open folder in VS Code or the terminal, and you can pick one up where you left off.
body.zh: 历史菜单现在会列出你在 VS Code 或终端里为当前文件夹开启的会话，选中即可从上次停下的地方继续。

fixes.en: ⌘-scroll zooms the PDF, and pinching over the PDF no longer zooms the whole workspace.
fixes.zh: ⌘ + 滚动可以缩放 PDF，在 PDF 上双指捏合也不会再缩放整个工作区。

fixes.en: Overleaf: a full sync no longer stops you from creating or deleting files, a stalled download retries, and the download shows its progress.
fixes.zh: Overleaf：完整同步时也能新建和删除文件，下载卡住时会自动重试，并显示下载进度。

fixes.en: Opening an Overleaf project that a local folder already links opens that folder instead of downloading a second copy.
fixes.zh: 打开一个已经关联到本地文件夹的 Overleaf 项目时，会直接打开那个文件夹，不再重复下载一份。

fixes.en: The AI assistant's prompt box stays inside a short panel while you type a long prompt.
fixes.zh: 在较矮的面板里输入长提示词时，AI 助手的输入框不会再超出面板。

fixes.en: The AI assistant's rate-limit notice keeps its close button on the first line, reads fully in your language, and shows reset times you can read at a glance.
fixes.zh: AI 助手的用量限制提示把关闭按钮保持在第一行，全部内容都用你的语言显示，重置时间也一目了然。
